# Local dry-run fixtures

Static HTML for local parsing exercises only. Do **not** point missions at unauthorized external hosts.

| File | Illustrates |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` | WordPress generator meta, a Swagger UI link, and a PDF document link |

Serve with any loopback static server (for example `python3 -m http.server` in this directory) if you want a local dry-run. The package runtime smoke test does not require these files.
